title: Capacity onboarding + request estimator for Dedicated pools
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Create a lightweight, end-to-end provisioning workflow for Dedicated capacity requests that combines a user-facing intake form, an automated capacity/throughput estimator, staged approvals, and a clear handoff to Fleet/Infra. Goals: 1) reduce manual back-and-forth between Sales/Customer Success and Infra by capturing required signals up-front; 2) provide realistic throughput guarantees and autoscaling policy recommendations based on typical workload patterns; 3) ensure auditability and SLA metadata are attached to the reservation for later rollouts and billing. Scope: intake form (UI + API), estimator engine (heuristic model + defaults), approval states (review queue, infra validation, legal/compliance check for private deployments), and a follow-up task template for capacity provisioning and monitoring setup. Out of scope for this ticket: billing integration, reserved-contract negotiation language, and on-prem install automation.
acceptance_criteria: A user-facing intake form exists in Console (new route) that captures: expected QPS, 95th latency target, model family, sequence length percentile, traffic pattern (steady/diurnal/spiky), preferred region, and compliance requirements.
Estimator returns a recommended fleet shape (GPU count, instance type mix, initial replicas) and an estimated monthly token-hour cost with +/-20% confidence band.
Approval workflow with at least three states: Request Submitted, Infra Validating, Approved (or Rejected). Each transition adds an audit entry with actor and timestamp.

A generated provisioning checklist (linkable task) is created on approval containing rollout steps: quota provisioning, autoscaling policy baseline, monitoring dashboard seed, and canary rollout plan.
Integration points documented: Confluence PRD + endpoint spec, and a prototype UI mock linked to the ticket.
